notes: No shared edits beyond the two registry lines. planes reuses packages/avfilter/src/activation/integer-option.ts.

Linux-gated float cases: two tests (API and CLI float). No macOS run was measured; the gate is a precaution backed by emulation: a fused Math.fround(|sum|*scale+delta) fails the float API test (first at yuv444p 5x3 scale=0.7:delta=-0.1), so the float cases do separate fused from unfused arithmetic.

Borders: setup_3x3 uses avpriv_mirror (-1 -> 1, n -> n-2, single row/column -> 0), not replication; 1- and 2-pixel planes stay in bounds and are supported, matched natively at 1x1, 2x2, 1x8, 2x8 and 8x1.
The registry test file was not edited; the examples are on the descriptor.
Environment: sandbox Node was v22.23.5; bootstrap requires Node 24, so the official v24.22.3 linux-x64 tarball (sha256-checked against SHASUMS256.txt) was unpacked into the session scratchpad.

Setup durations: bootstrap 199 s (npm 9.4 s, submodule 7.0 s, reference build the rest); baseline typecheck, lint, boundaries and the registry test 63 s, all green (8/8). The differential file runs in about 40 s on 4 vCPUs.
